t: Listen to a conversation between a student and a housing office employee.
Hi, how can I help you?
I'm in a double room in Baker Hall.
My roommate is fine, actually, we get along well.
But I have an early job next semester, and I want to move to a single room so I don't wake her up.
Unfortunately, all the single rooms are taken right now.
But you can join the waitlist.
I'll email you the form today.
